clips.title: The story
paras: At Splintertree Post, Pixel carries Warsong goods through dangerous lands for a fee. She keeps the saw blades until she is paid, and looks for other cargo worth carrying.

Pixel carries freight for the Warsong Clan from Splintertree Post, where the Horde holds a fortified post in Ashenvale. She takes goods through active war zones to support the clan’s logging work, but coin and contracts guide her choices. The saw blades stay with her until she receives payment. For this shipment, she wants a deadly blunderbuss to guard herself on the road. Pixel also pays travelers for satyr horns, which are in high demand in Ratchet.
